items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter and Billy Taylor and all those cats like that, Dickie Wells and Sidney de Paris, see what I mean?

ctx.x: Billy Taylor was one of the greatest of the bass players I ever heard, bass horn, you know. I'm working in a great band, that was just some extry money. So when those guys in Europe says "Did you really work with King Oliver?" I could, I would get sarcastic and told 'em that "No", like I got tired of answering the question, you know what I mean? 'Cause he wasn't that big to me, you know, see what I mean - he was big to the public, because - "King Oliver, that's great!" I worked with a better band, see what I…
